name: Parking and Traffic Commission Meeting
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  PARKING AND TRAFFIC COMMISSION (PTC)
  One West Manchester Blvd., Inglewood, CA 90301
  City Hall Lobby Community Room A
  February 26, 2025 7:00pm

  FEBRUARY AGENDA

  Angela Allen, City Treasuer
Barbara Hibler, Chairperson
  Destinee Wesley, Secretary
Richard Galindo, District 1  Peter Puglese, City Traffic Engineer
Kip Rudd, District 2  Diana Maximo, Parking and Traffic Department
Brett C.S. Roberts, District 3  William Thompson, Parking and Traffic Department
Lois Hale, District 4  Lieutenant David Salcedo, Police Department

Rules of Decorum
https://www.cityofinglewood.org/DocumentCenter/View/18857/2023-Rules-of-Decorum

A. OPENING CEREMONIES
1. Roll Call

B. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING AGENDA ITEMS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any item on the agenda may do
  so at this time.

C. APPROVAL OF MINUTES
1. Approval of the minutes for the meeting held on January 22, 2025.

D. NEW BUSINESS
1. YOLA Circulation
2. Gay St at 68th parking
3. Presentation from LAZ

E. PUBLIC COMMENTS REGARDING OTHER MATTERS
1. Persons wishing to address the Parking and Traffic Commission on any matter connected with City
  business not elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

F. CHAIRPERSON AND COMMISSIONERS REMARKS
1. Members of the Parking and Traffic Commission will provide oral reports on any matter they
  consider to be of general interest to the public.

G. ANNOUNCEMENTS
1. The next Parking and Traffic Commission meeting will be held on Wednesday, March 26, 2024 at
  7:00 p.m., First Floor, City Hall Community Room A, Inglewood City Hall One Manchester Blvd.,
  Inglewood, CA 90301.

H. ADJOURNMENT

FEBRUARY 2025

  1
